verdict.rationale: Logseq's own Sync docs confirm that Android and iOS apps exist and that whole graphs sync to them, which implies the full knowledge base is reachable on mobile. Nothing in the pack shows that capture, search and linking work on mobile at desktop depth rather than as a companion. Missing for 10: documentation of mobile feature parity for capture, search, page/block linking and queries on iOS/Android, and independent or hands-on reports of mobile app quality.

support.subject: As a power-user, full-featured iOS and Android apps give me my whole knowledge base — capture, search, and linking — not a stripped-down companion

citations.quote: Syncs up to 10 graphs between Logseq Desktop, Android, and iOS.
